comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: I will never look at my morning 'Mocha' the same way again ☕🤯. To think that a 600-year-old port in Yemen gave the entire world its coffee culture, and the Dutch literally had to smuggle seedlings to break the monopoly... This is the kind of history they don't teach us in school!

replies.author: @reallifeincountries
replies.text: "Coffee history truly reads like a spy thriller! ☕ 🕵️‍♂️ From Mocha, Yemen to global obsession—it's incredible how one crop changed trade forever. How many cups of coffee do you usually drink a day while watching docs?"
